newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Thursday due to low buying by textile mills, dealers at the private Karachi Cotton Association said.
Rates fluctuated slightly in the kerb market where mills with ready cash purchased at a lower rate than the prevailing rates at the KCA, one broker said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was quoted 2,100/2,250 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 2,450/2,475 and MNH-93 2,460/2,485, the broker said.
Prices are likely to open unchanged on Friday, the broker said.
